name: Export HTML File
purpose: Exports the generated chart HTML (field charts::opportunitiesCharts) to index.html in the temporary folder and returns the file path (adjusted on Windows), also kept in $$path, so a web viewer can load it.
external: Export Field Contents (step 5; writes index.html to Get(TemporaryPath))
open_question: The chart HTML itself is built by the field calculation in charts::opportunitiesCharts. Only caller is a TEST script in karbon_kontacts.

name: Load Widget - TodaysTimeActivity
purpose: Loads the "Today's Time Activity" chart widget into a web viewer: puts a sample list of people with hours, billable hours and dollars into $Data, compiles the widget HTML with Compile Widget (script 1252) and shows it in the web viewer named TodaysTimeActivityWebViewer. Shows a dialog if compile or load fails.
callers: none found (may be called by name)
external: Set Web Viewer (step 29; loads the compiled HTML in web viewer TodaysTimeActivityWebViewer)
open_question: Step 16 (Insert Text of example data into $Data) is live, with the comment "comment this out when you get your real data", so the widget always shows the sample data (Todd Geist, Dave Graham). There is no real data source yet. Is the widget used in production?
